QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] Rebellious Movement
QuestInfo.0: #m310000000#'s watchman #b#p2152016##k has something for you to do.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p2152016#, a few town residents are plotting to fight against the Black Wings. The leader of the group is apparently #b#m310000003##k's #b#p2150003##k! #p2152016# wants you to interrogate #p2150003#.
QuestInfo.2: #p2150003# denied doing anything dangerous like that. But, he did admit doing something at 6pm in #m310000003#.
